136.news_title: Replacement 4x3 monitor for your 33inch 38inch and 39inch CRT Tube Monitors
136.long_description: Our biggest 4x3 33inch monitor solution is being released soon, offering a plug and play solution for all your 15khz, 24khz, 31khz arcade game machines. Using our customer firmware, our 33inch LCD panels also offer 1600x1200 support through RGB, VGA or HDMI input. Keep the traditional size and aspect ratio with our 33inch 4:3 arcade LCD monitor. Preorders open in February, with delivery expected in April/May. For more information and to pre-order please visit https://www.arcooda.com/buy/33-inch-Arcooda-4-3-LCD-Arcade-Monitor-15khz-25khz-31khz-to-1080P-up-to-1600x1200-20187
